answer: Because the oasis liability is written down in the vertex ledger at admission, the echo audit makes public the shared exposure and internal sponsorship is self-defeating. A sponsor carries 49% of any slash its member incurs, so vouching is a financial position rather than a courtesy. A farm must hence place its own capital behind every sock puppet it sponsors, which is the same as paying the bond twice for each key it runs. That is 19 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
